Priya (CS): Heads-up — prepping QBR for Solstice Health next Tue. They've had a 3x jump in embeddings this cycle; need to align on token econ, spend forecast, and a short enablement plan. Can we capture risks so Ava can negotiate renewal?
Ethan (FinOps): On it. Pulling last 30d usage now. Do you want: baseline, commit-aligned forecast, and a high-usage tail scenario (95th pct)?
Marcos (Onboarding): I noticed they flipped caching on last week but not prefix caching across routes — embeddings unchanged. I'll list outstanding onboarding items that could reduce churn.
Olivia (Eval): If we propose a quantized variant (4-bit) to cut cost, I can run a quick quality delta on the 50 prompt set. Need to know which model family they're on.
Ava (AM): They're on redwood-embed-large-v2 for embeddings, and chat-prod-8k for conversational. Their ask: keep perceived quality same and get a predictable spend. They mentioned considering a 6-12 month commit.
Priya (CS): Proposed playbook for QBR: 1) Forecast sheet (Ethan) 2) Canary plan (Marcos + Eng) 3) Budget alerts + auto-fallback (billing-bot) 4) Prep slides with 3 charts (Olivia). Who owns alerts?
Ethan (FinOps): @billing-bot can we create a monthly threshold alert at 60% of their proposed commit and a hard stop action to route to lower-cost variant? also need per-route throttles.
billing-bot: Created alert rule: SolsticeHealth_monthly_threshold_60 -> notifies #cs-ops + email ava@redwood.com. Can add auto-fallback route: chat-prod-8k -> chat-prod-8k-quant (fallback).
Marcos (Onboarding): I'll stage canary config. Quick command to change embedding batch sizes / cache TTL in Dedicated staging: ```rdwctl set route solstice embeddings batch_size=512 cache_ttl=86400``` Will run perf and token delta.
Olivia (Eval): I'll run the 50-prompt eval against chat-prod-8k and chat-prod-8k-quant. Expected outputs: accuracy, sacreBLEU-like sim, and human-annotated pass/fail for 20 samples. Results by EOD tom.
Ava (AM): Customer feedback: they'd trade some latency for cost but will not accept >15% quality delta. They want a guaranteed spend corridor if we do a commit. Put that in negotiation notes.
Priya (CS): Action items roundup: - Ethan: forecast CSV + 3-scenario CI by EOD today. - Marcos: staging canary perf + token usage numbers by tomorrow morning. - Olivia: eval quality delta + sample diffs. - Ava: confirm renewal window + how many seats, and capture customer's preferred KPI (latency vs accuracy). Marcos/Ethan: please add any short ops runbook lines for the QBR (one-liners) we can paste into slides.
Marcos (Onboarding): Ops runbook snippet: "If monthly spend > 80% of commit AND error-rate < 1% then enable fallback route at 10% traffic, notify AM and CS". Also adding step: "If cache hit rate < 30% investigate prefix keying and index TTLs."
Ethan (FinOps): Quick forecast sample (first rows):
route,30d_tokens,baseline_monthly_est,commit_aligned_est,95pct_tail_est
embeddings,12,45000000,40000000,62000000
chat,8,21000000,18000000,35000000
(Full CSV in drive link when ready)
Priya (CS): Perfect. Olivia — can you drop the eval doc link here once ready? Also, Marcos, please attach the canary k8s/rdw config for the runbook.
Olivia (Eval): Will do. I'll include a short human-review summary: HEADLINE = quantize saves ~28% tokens-cost for generation path, embeddings unaffected; estimated quality delta ~6% on our benchmark.
Ava (AM): Great — I'll use the numbers to open negotiation: commit + SLA for <15% delta and a rollback clause if user-facing metrics degrade.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. I'll stitch slides and share the draft in #qbr-deck for review by EOD. Ping me for anything urgent. :thumbsup:
